title: Compact Robot Policies Need Fine-Grained Visual Representations
title_zh: 紧凑型机器人策略需要精细的视觉表示

paragraphs.en: Multi-task manipulation policies differ in architecture, scale, and pretrained priors all at once, so published comparisons cannot attribute performance to any single component. We argue that most of it comes from the visual representation, and that parameter scale and generative priors are largely incidental . To test this, we build CoRP (Compressed Representation Policy), a deliberately compact policy ( 48.9M parameters, no vision-language model and no video-generative prior ) that factorizes into a representation extractor and a flow-matching action generator. It reaches 97.0% on LIBERO and 75.78%/73.36% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized , matching systems 40.9–163.6× larger. Holding the action generator fixed, we then vary one extractor property at a time. Pretrained initialization is decisive : a random ViT-S/14 drops to 78.1% and an ImageNet ResNet-34 to 74.5% on LIBERO. Pretraining alone is not enough, as freezing the encoder costs 19.8 points. Compression matters as much : resampling each view to 48 tokens beats passing all patch tokens ( 97.0% vs 83.2% ), and a variational information bottleneck over those tokens is worse than a hard token budget, cutting LIBERO-Goal from 95.8% to 33.0% by suppressing the instruction-dependent token selection the policy relies on. Language conditioning contributes only where the observation leaves the goal ambiguous (LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% to 95.8%), while on RoboTwin 2.0, where observations are unambiguous, removing it slightly improves success. Therefore, we argue that a compact policy works when its representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed. Project page: https://corp-policy.github.io/
paragraphs.zh: 多任务操控策略在架构、规模和预训练先验方面同时存在差异，因此已发表的比较研究无法将性能归因于任何单一组件。 我们认为，这些差异主要源于视觉表示，而参数规模和生成先验在很大程度上只是附带因素。 为了验证这一点，我们构建了 CoRP（压缩表示策略），这是一种刻意设计的紧凑型策略（4890 万个参数，不包含视觉-语言模型和视频生成先验），可分解为一个表示提取器和一个流匹配动作生成器。 它在 LIBERO 上达到了 97.0% 的性能，在 RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized 上分别达到 75.78%/73.36%，与规模大 40.9–163.6 倍的系统相当。 在保持动作生成器不变的前提下，我们接着逐一改变提取器的单个属性。 预训练初始化具有决定性作用：随机初始化的 ViT-S/14 在 LIBERO 上的性能降至 78.1%，而 ImageNet ResNet-34 则降至 74.5%。 仅靠预训练并不足够，因为冻结编码器会导致性能损失 19.8 个百分点。 压缩同样至关重要：将每个视角重新采样为 48 个标记比直接传递所有块标记更优（97.0% vs 83.2%）；而对这些标记应用变分信息瓶颈的效果则不如硬性限制标记数量，它通过将策略所依赖的指令相关标记选择予以抑制，使 LIBERO-Goal 的性能从 95.8% 骤降至 33.0%。 语言条件仅在观察结果导致目标模糊时才会产生贡献（LIBERO-Goal：从 9.2% 提升至 95.8%）；而在观察结果无歧义的 RoboTwin 2.0 上，移除语言条件反而略微提升了成功率。 因此，我们认为，当策略的表示经过预训练、任务适配和压缩时，紧凑型策略便能有效运行。 项目页面：https://corp-policy.github.io/

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have become the dominant paradigm for multi-task robotic manipulation, mapping images and language instructions directly to robot actions ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025b ) . These systems typically couple a pretrained vision–language model (VLM) with a generative action head, carrying billions of parameters to generalize across tasks ( Kim et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025b ) . More recently, world-action models (WAMs) go further, adding video-generative priors that jointly predict future observations and robot actions ( Ye and others, 2026 ) . Because these systems differ in architecture, scale, pretraining, data, and training recipes, we cannot attribute their success to any single component.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）已成为多任务机器人操作的主流范式，它将图像和语言指令直接映射为机器人动作（Zitkovich 等人，2023；Kim 等人，2025b；Black 等人，2025b）。 这些系统通常将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与生成式动作头相结合，包含数十亿参数以实现跨任务泛化（Kim 等人，2025b；Black 等人，2025b）。 近期，世界-动作模型（WAMs）更进一步，增加了视频生成先验，能够联合预测未来观察结果和机器人动作（Ye 及其他人，2026）。 由于这些系统在架构、规模、预训练、数据和训练方法上各不相同，我们无法将其成功归因于任何单一组件。

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Compressed Representation Policy (CoRP) , a 48.9M-parameter policy without any VLM or video-generative prior that is competitive with systems up to 163× larger on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, and serves as a controlled testbed for isolating the role of representation.
paragraphs.zh: 压缩表示策略（CoRP）是一种包含4890万个参数的策略，无需任何视觉语言模型（VLM）或视频生成先验知识，在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0测试中可与规模大至163倍的系统相媲美，并作为一个受控的测试平台，用于分离表示的作用。

paragraphs.en: A controlled ablation study shows that effective compact policies require visual representations that are pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed, and that language helps only when the goal is visually ambiguous.
paragraphs.zh: 一项受控的消融研究表明，有效的紧凑策略需要预先训练、任务适配且经过压缩的视觉表示，而语言仅在目标在视觉上存在歧义时才能提供帮助。

paragraphs.en: Real-robot validation on three bimanual tasks (closed-loop adaptation to object displacement, coordinated two-arm placement, and precision plug insertion), providing qualitative evidence that CoRP, pretrained on our large-scale real-world corpus, transfers to physical hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 在三项双手任务（对物体位移的闭环自适应、双臂协同放置以及精密插头插入）上进行了真实机器人验证，这为以下结论提供了定性证据：基于我们大规模真实世界语料库预训练的 CoRP 能够迁移到物理硬件中。

paragraphs.en: Generative and Pretrained Policies. Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) and ACT ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) established generative action heads as strong baselines for visuomotor control, but each model trains on a single task. Octo ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ) scaled such policies across tasks and embodiments by pretraining on large multi-robot datasets, but learns its visual tokenizer from robot data rather than initializing it from a large-scale pretrained vision model, a choice our encoder ablation examines directly (Section 4.3 ). VLAs instead build the policy on a pretrained vision–language model to inherit its richer visual and semantic representations ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025a ) . World-action models add video-generative priors to target temporal and physical generalization, either alongside a vision–language understanding module ( Bi et al., 2026 ) or in place of it ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Across both lines, however, the visual pathway changes alongside the language model, the generative prior, and the parameter count, so no single factor can be credited with the gains. In contrast, we hold a small flow-matching action generator fixed and vary only the representation extractor, testing how far a compact policy can go without either prior.
paragraphs.zh: 生成与预训练策略。 Diffusion Policy（Chi 等人，2023）和 ACT（Zhao 等人，2023）将生成式动作头确立为视觉运动控制的强大基线，但每个模型都仅在单一任务上进行训练。 Octo（Ghosh 等人，2024）通过在大型多机器人数据集上进行预训练，将此类策略扩展到了多个任务和具身形式，但其视觉分词器是从机器人数据中学习得到的，而非从大规模预训练的视觉模型中初始化；我们的编码器消融分析直接检验了这一选择（第 4.3 节）。 相比之下，VLA 在预训练的视觉-语言模型上构建策略，从而继承其更丰富的视觉和语义表示（Zitkovich 等人，2023；Kim 等人，2025b；Black 等人，2025b；Black 等人，2025a）。 World-action 模型为视频生成先验添加了目标时间性和物理性泛化能力，这些先验可以与视觉-语言理解模块并行使用（Bi 等人，2026），也可以替代该模块（Yuan 等人，2026）。 然而，在这两种方法中，视觉通路都会随着语言模型、生成式先验和参数数量的变化而改变，因此无法将性能提升归因于单一因素。 相比之下，我们保持一个小型流匹配动作生成器固定不变，仅改变表示提取器，以测试在没有任何先验的情况下，一个紧凑的策略能达到何种程度。

paragraphs.en: Visual Representation Learning. Supervised pretraining on large labeled datasets established convolutional ( He et al., 2016 ) and patch-based Transformer ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) backbones as sources of transferable visual features, and our ImageNet ResNet-34 ablation follows this recipe. Self-supervised methods remove the need for labels: the DINO series ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ) yields the fine-grained patch features our resampler consumes. Recent work pushes further toward dense geometric structure, for example through masked boundary modeling ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . Another line pretrains representations specifically for manipulation from human video, masked image modeling, or sensorimotor prediction ( Nair et al., 2023 ; Radosavovic et al., 2023 ; Majumdar et al., 2023 ) , and finds that the benefit of pretrained features varies substantially across tasks and evaluation settings ( Burns et al., 2025 ; Hansen et al., 2023 ) . However, these studies mostly evaluate frozen features with single-task or lightweight policy heads, leaving open how initialization, fine-tuning, and token compression jointly shape a multi-task, language-conditioned generative policy. We address this gap by comparing a DINOv2-initialized ViT-S/14 against random and ImageNet-supervised alternatives, frozen and fine-tuned, under an identical action generator (Sections 4.3 and 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 视觉表示学习。 在大型带标签数据集上进行监督预训练，确立了卷积网络（He et al., 2016）和基于图像块的Transformer（Dosovitskiy et al., 2021）骨干网络作为可迁移视觉特征的来源，而我们的ImageNet ResNet-34消融研究遵循了这一方法。 自监督方法无需标签：DINO系列（Caron et al., 2021；Oquab et al., 2024；Siméoni et al., 2026）生成了我们重采样器所使用的高粒度图像块特征。 近期的研究进一步推动了密集几何结构的探索，例如通过掩码边界建模（Fu et al., 2026）。 另一类研究专门针对从人类视频、掩码图像建模或传感器-运动预测中获取的输入进行表示预训练（Nair et al., 2023；Radosavovic et al., 2023；Majumdar et al., 2023），并发现预训练特征带来的益处因任务和评估设置的不同而存在显著差异（Burns et al., 2025；Hansen et al., 2023）。 然而，这些研究大多仅通过单任务或轻量级策略头来评估冻结特征，因此初始化、微调与标记压缩如何共同塑造一个多任务、语言条件化的生成策略仍是一个开放问题。 我们通过将DINOv2初始化的ViT-S/14与随机初始化和ImageNet监督初始化的替代方案进行比较（包括冻结和微调版本），并在完全相同的动作生成器下进行评估（第4.3节和第4.4节），从而填补了这一研究空白。

paragraphs.en: The action generator is an L L -block, width- d d DiT-style Transformer ( L = 1 L=1 by default). It linearly projects the noisy action chunk into H H action tokens with learned positional embeddings. The interpolation time τ \tau is embedded with sinusoidal encoding and an MLP, then added to every action token. 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} is prepended to the action tokens as a prefix; the attention mask lets prefix tokens attend only to the prefix and action tokens attend to the prefix and all action tokens, keeping 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} independent of the noisy actions. Each block also applies an adaptive LayerNorm (adaLN) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) with scale and shift computed from 𝐮 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{u}} , so the instruction conditions every layer rather than only the resampler. The DiT then predicts a velocity for each action token (Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 动作生成器是一个 L-L 块，采用宽度为 d-d 的 DiT 风格 Transformer（默认情况下 L=1）。 它将带有噪声的动作片段线性投影为 H 个动作令牌，并加入可学习的位置嵌入。 插值时间 τ 通过正弦编码和 MLP 进行嵌入，然后添加到每个动作令牌中。𝐳 t 作为前缀附加到动作令牌之前；注意力掩码允许前缀令牌仅关注前缀，而动作令牌则关注前缀和所有动作令牌，从而保持 𝐳 t 与带有噪声的动作无关。 每个块还应用自适应层归一化（adaLN）（Peebles 和 Xie, 2023），其缩放和偏移量由 𝐮 ¯ 计算得出，因此指令会条件控制每一层，而不仅仅是重采样器。 随后，DiT 会为每个动作令牌预测一个速度（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our primary metric is task success rate (%), following each benchmark’s protocol ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) : 50 trials per task on LIBERO, reported per suite and averaged over 40 tasks; 100 trials per task on RoboTwin 2.0, averaged over 50 tasks per setting (per-task results in Table 8 ). We also report task-head accuracy (%, Eq. ( 7 )) on each evaluation episode’s first frame, measuring how well the visual prefix identifies the task. To measure action-relevant information without closed-loop execution, we freeze f ϕ f_{\phi} and train a lightweight probe to predict action chunks from the visual prefix ( Radosavovic et al., 2023 ; Nikulin et al., 2025 ) , reporting its NMAE (per-dimension, normalized by the 1st–99th percentile range; lower is better) and R 2 R^{2} (higher is better) on a held-out split (Eq. ( 12 ), details in A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要指标是任务成功率（%），遵循各基准测试的协议（Liu et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2026）：在 LIBERO 上，每个任务进行 50 次试验，按套件报告并跨 40 个任务取平均；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，每个任务进行 100 次试验，按设置跨 50 个任务取平均（各任务结果见表 8）。我们还报告了每个评估回合第一帧的任务头准确率（%，公式 (7)），用于衡量视觉前缀识别任务的能力。为在不执行闭环操作的情况下衡量与动作相关的信息，我们冻结 f ϕ f_{\phi}，并训练一个轻量级探针，从视觉前缀中预测动作片段（Radosavovic et al., 2023；Nikulin et al., 2025），报告其在预留测试集上的 NMAE（按维度计算，以第 1–99 百分位范围进行归一化；数值越低越好）和 R²（数值越高越好）（公式 (12)，详见 A.1）。

paragraphs.en: On RoboTwin 2.0 (Clean/Randomized), CoRP (75.8%/73.4%) outperforms X-VLA (72.9%/72.8%) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} (43.0%/43.8%) and approaches Motus without video pretraining (77.6%/77.0%) with about 160 × \times fewer parameters, but stays below pretrained Motus (88.7%/87.0%) and GigaWorld-Policy (86.4%/85.0%). paragraphs.en: The answer is YES: the DINOv2-initialized ViT-S/14 outperforms every other encoder variant by at least 14.9 points in average LIBERO success.

paragraphs.en: To separate the effect of pretraining from that of architecture, we cross two initializations, pretrained or random, with two parameter-matched architectures in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 design. The ViT-S/14 ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) (22.1M, default) is pretrained from a DINOv2 checkpoint ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) and the ResNet-34 (21.5M) from ImageNet-supervised weights ( He et al., 2016 ; Deng et al., 2009 ) ; the ResNet’s final feature map provides 49 spatial tokens per view to the resampler.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将预训练的影响与架构的影响区分开来，我们在一个 2 × 2 的设计中，将两种初始化方式（预训练或随机）与两种参数匹配的架构进行交叉组合。 ViT-S/14（Dosovitskiy 等人，2021）（22.1M，默认设置）是从 DINOv2 检查点（Oquab 等人，2024）预训练的，而 ResNet-34（21.5M）则来自通过 ImageNet 监督训练的权重（He 等人，2016；Deng 等人，2009）；ResNet 的最终特征图每视图为重新采样器提供 49 个空间标记。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows that the pretrained ViT achieves the highest success rate on every suite (97.0% on average) and the most action-decodable visual prefix (NMAE 0.07, R 2 = 0.81 R^{2}=0.81 ). Neither factor alone explains this gain: with random initialization, the ViT is no better than the ResNet (78.1% vs. 82.1%), and ImageNet pretraining even lowers the ResNet’s success (74.5% vs. 82.1%). The gain therefore requires combining the two, consistent with DINOv2’s patch-level pretraining providing fine-grained spatial features for the resampler to select from. Separating this from the benefit of any pretrained ViT would require a supervised-pretrained ViT control, which we leave to future work. All four variants identify the task with 100% accuracy, yet the pretrained ResNet reaches only a 37.0% success rate on LIBERO-Goal: these policies know which task to perform but lack the fine-grained visual information needed to do so.
paragraphs.zh: 表3显示，预训练的ViT在每个套件上都实现了最高的成功率（平均97.0%），并且具有最多的可解码动作的视觉前缀（NMAE 0.07，R² = 0.81 R^{2}=0.81）。 仅凭这两个因素中的任何一个都无法解释这种提升：在随机初始化的情况下，ViT的表现并不优于ResNet（78.1% vs. 82.1%），而ImageNet预训练甚至降低了ResNet的成功率（74.5% vs. 82.1%）。 因此，这种提升需要将两者结合，这与DINOv2的块级预训练为重采样器提供了可供选择的精细空间特征的做法一致。 要将这一点与任何预训练ViT带来的益处区分开来，需要一个经过监督预训练的ViT作为对照，但我们将此留待未来的工作。 所有四种变体都以100%的准确率识别了任务，但预训练的ResNet在LIBERO-Goal上的成功率仅为37.0%：这些策略知道需要执行哪项任务，但缺乏完成该任务所需的精细视觉信息。

paragraphs.en: The frozen policy (77.2%) performs no better than a randomly initialized ViT trained end-to-end (78.1%, Table 3 ), so pretraining pays off only when the features adapt to the task. The probe shows why: freezing reduces R 2 R^{2} from 0.81 to 0.24 and doubles NMAE (0.07 to 0.16), indicating that frozen features retain much less action-relevant detail, and t-SNE analysis ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) (Figure 2 ) shows that, after fine-tuning, representations at similar episode stages cluster more closely. They are also more clearly ordered from early to late stages.

paragraphs.en: The answer is yes, but not every bottleneck formulation helps : a hard, instruction-aware token budget raises average LIBERO success from 83.2% to 97.0%, whereas a variational bottleneck lowers success with or without it. The information bottleneck (IB) principle ( Tishby et al., 1999 ) seeks a representation Z Z of the input X X that is maximally informative about a target Y Y while discarding the rest of X X , i.e., max p ⁡ ( Z ∣ X ) ⁡ I ⁡ ( Z , Y ) − β IB ​ I ​ ( Z , X ) \max_{p(Z\mid X)}I(Z;Y)-\beta_{\mathrm{IB}}I(Z;X) with β IB > 0 \beta_{\mathrm{IB}}>0 ; here, X X is the visual input, Z Z the visual prefix, and Y Y the action chunk. A common tractable surrogate is the deep variational information bottleneck (VIB) ( Alemi et al., 2017 ) , which adds β IB D KL ( q ( Z ∣ X ) ∥ 𝒩 ( 𝟎 , 𝐈 ) ) \beta_{\mathrm{IB}}D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q(Z\mid X)\,\|\,\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},\mathbf{I})) to a prediction loss, where q ⁡ ( Z ∣ X ) q(Z\mid X) is a Gaussian encoder. In our VIB variants, we add this KL term on each visual token to our training loss (Eq. ( 9 )), with β IB = 4 × 10 − 8 \beta_{\mathrm{IB}}=4\times 10^{-8} (Appendix A.1 ). However, the KL penalty is task-agnostic: it compresses every token toward the same prior, regardless of which visual details the current instruction requires. Our resampler instead imposes a hard, instruction-aware bottleneck: capacity is limited to K ≪ P K\ll P tokens but allocated according to the instruction through the FiLM-modulated queries. We cross the two choices in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 design: with or without the resampler, and with or without VIB. Without the resampler ( All Tokens ), all P = 256 P=256 projected patch tokens per view enter the visual prefix. In this case, 𝐮 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{u}} directly modulates every patch token.
paragraphs.zh: 答案是肯定的，但并非每种瓶颈设计都有帮助：一种严格的、指令感知的令牌预算将 LIBERO 的平均成功率从 83.2% 提升至 97.0%，而变分瓶颈无论是否使用该预算，都会降低成功率。信息瓶颈（IB）原理（Tishby 等人，1999）旨在为输入 X 寻找一个表示 Z，使得 Z 能够最大限度地提供关于目标 Y 的信息，同时丢弃 X 的其他部分，即：max p(Z∣X)I(Z;Y)−βIBI(Z;X)，其中 βIB>0；在此，X 是视觉输入，Z 是视觉前缀，Y 是动作片段。一种常见且易于处理的替代方案是深度变分信息瓶颈（VIB）（Alemi 等人，2017），它会在预测损失中加入 βIBDKL(q(Z∣X)∥N(0,I))，其中 q(Z∣X) 是一个高斯编码器。在我们的 VIB 变体中，我们在每个视觉令牌上将该 KL 项加入训练损失（公式 (9)），其中 βIB=4×10−8（附录 A.1）。然而，KL 惩罚项与具体任务无关：它会压缩所有令牌，使其趋向于相同的先验分布，而不管当前指令需要哪些视觉细节。相比之下，我们的重采样器施加了一种严格的、指令感知的瓶颈：容量被限制为 K≪P 个令牌，但会根据指令通过 FiLM 调制的查询进行分配。我们在一个 2×2 的设计中交叉比较了这两种选择：使用或不使用重采样器，以及使用或不使用 VIB。在没有重采样器的情况下（所有令牌），每个视图的全部 P=256 个投影块令牌都会进入视觉前缀。在这种情况下，u¯ 会直接调制每个块令牌。

paragraphs.en: Adding VIB undoes this selection: on the resampled prefix, it reduces the instruction-induced change from 49.7% to 13.6% and Goal success from 95.8% to 33.0%; on All Tokens, it lowers average success from 83.2% to 77.8%. paragraphs.en: Finally, we test whether CoRP transfers to physical hardware on three bimanual tasks that probe closed-loop adaptation, arm coordination, and precision. Unlike in simulation, we pretrain the unchanged 48.9M-parameter CoRP on more than 10,000 hours of real-world data covering 5,887 tasks on our dual-arm robots, then fine-tune it on 10 tasks (Appendix A.5 ). We evaluate three of these tasks over 10 trials each with randomized initial object placements. The policy uses three cameras, one on the head and one on each arm, and runs synchronously at about 7 ms per chunk.

paragraphs.en: Plug insertion. The robot unplugs a charger from the right socket, transfers it, and inserts it into the left socket (Figure 5 ). Successful insertion requires aligning the pins with the socket openings in both position and orientation and maintaining that alignment as the pins enter. It thus tests precision manipulation under geometric constraints, complementing the simulated peg-insertion task in Appendix A.3 (8.0 mm peg, 8.1 mm hole), where CoRP reaches 84% success. CoRP completes the insertion in 2 trials. paragraphs.en: We presented CoRP, a 48.9M-parameter manipulation policy without a VLM or video-generative prior, and used it as a controlled testbed to ask where a multi-task policy’s performance comes from. By holding the action generator fixed and varying one property of the representation extractor at a time, we find that a compact policy works when its visual representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed: removing any one of these properties costs 14–20 points on LIBERO, while language matters only when the scene leaves the goal ambiguous. With these properties, CoRP is competitive with systems up to 163 × \times larger on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and transfers unchanged to real bimanual robots. Across our ablations, the weaker variants still identify the task but fail to perform it, suggesting that compact policies lack not task knowledge but fine-grained, instruction-specific visual detail. Our study has several limitations that are worth exploring in future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CoRP，这是一个包含 4890 万个参数的操控策略，且没有使用视觉语言模型（VLM）或视频生成先验知识，并将其用作受控测试平台，以探究多任务策略的性能来源。 通过固定动作生成器，并逐一对表示提取器的某个属性进行变化，我们发现：当视觉表示经过预训练、任务适配和压缩时，紧凑策略能够正常运行；若移除其中任意一个属性，在 LIBERO 上的得分将下降 14–20 分，而语言信息仅在场景使目标变得模糊时才会产生影响。 具备这些特性后，CoRP 在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上的表现可与体积大至 163 倍的系统相媲美，并且能够无变化地迁移到真实的双手机器人上。 在我们的消融实验中，较弱的变体仍然能够识别任务，但无法执行该任务，这表明紧凑策略所缺乏的并非任务知识，而是精细且与指令相关的视觉细节。 我们的研究存在若干局限性，值得在未来的工作中进一步探索。

paragraphs.en: Closed-set evaluation. Our benchmarks measure in-distribution control on closed task sets; we do not evaluate the open-world semantic and physical generalization that VLAs and WAMs target. paragraphs.en: We train for 80k steps on LIBERO and 120k steps on RoboTwin 2.0. We train directly on the original LIBERO dataset, while following Motus’s ( Bi et al., 2026 ) recipe to use 2,500 demonstrations collected in clean scenes (50 per task) plus 25,000 demonstrations collected in randomized scenes (500 per task). Both settings use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , batch size 392, BF16 training, gradient clipping at 1.0, and an EMA decay of 0.999. paragraphs.en: OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2025b ) adapts the vision–language backbone for robot action prediction. It combines a Llama 2 language model with visual features from DINOv2 and SigLIP, and is trained on heterogeneous robot demonstrations. Each continuous action dimension is quantized into discrete tokens, allowing the model to predict robot commands autoregressively from image observations and language instructions using a next-token prediction objective.
paragraphs.zh: OpenVLA（Kim 等人，2025b）将视觉-语言骨干网络应用于机器人动作预测。 它将 Llama 2 语言模型与 DINOv2 和 SigLIP 提取的视觉特征相结合，并在异构机器人演示数据上进行训练。 每个连续的动作维度都被量化为离散标记，使模型能够基于图像观察和语言指令，通过下一标记预测目标以自回归方式预测机器人命令。

sents.en: OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2025b ) adapts the vision–language backbone for robot action prediction.
sents.zh: OpenVLA（Kim 等人，2025b）将视觉-语言骨干网络应用于机器人动作预测。

sents.en: It combines a Llama 2 language model with visual features from DINOv2 and SigLIP, and is trained on heterogeneous robot demonstrations.
sents.zh: 它将 Llama 2 语言模型与 DINOv2 和 SigLIP 提取的视觉特征相结合，并在异构机器人演示数据上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: SmolVLA ( Shukor et al., 2025 ) combines a SmolVLM-2 backbone with a flow-matching action expert. The expert alternates self-attention over action tokens with cross-attention to multimodal features to generate continuous action chunks. Visual-token reduction and intermediate VLM layers reduce computational cost, while an asynchronous inference scheme can decouple action generation from execution. Our LIBERO comparison includes the 2.25B configuration reported in the original paper.
paragraphs.zh: SmolVLA（Shukor 等人，2025）将 SmolVLM-2 骨干网络与一个流匹配动作专家相结合。 该专家在动作标记上交替进行自注意力操作，并通过跨注意力机制关注多模态特征，以生成连续的动作片段。 视觉标记缩减和中间 VLM 层降低了计算成本，而异步推理方案则可以将动作生成与执行解耦。 我们的 LIBERO 对比实验包含了原始论文中报告的 2.25B 配置。

sents.en: SmolVLA ( Shukor et al., 2025 ) combines a SmolVLM-2 backbone with a flow-matching action expert.
sents.zh: SmolVLA（Shukor 等人，2025）将 SmolVLM-2 骨干网络与一个流匹配动作专家相结合。

sents.en: The expert alternates self-attention over action tokens with cross-attention to multimodal features to generate continuous action chunks.

paragraphs.en: π 𝟎 \mathbf{\pi_{0}} ( Black et al., 2025b ) couples a pretrained PaliGemma vision–language model with a dedicated action expert trained using flow matching. Images, language instructions, and proprioceptive states condition the generation of continuous action chunks, avoiding the need to discretize control outputs. Cross-embodiment robot pretraining combines general visual–language representations with motor supervision, after which the policy can be adapted to downstream manipulation tasks through task-specific post-training.
paragraphs.zh: π 𝟎 \mathbf{\pi_{0}} (Black et al., 2025b) 将预训练的 PaliGemma 视觉-语言模型与一个通过流匹配方法训练的专业动作专家模型相结合。 图像、语言指令和本体感觉状态共同条件化连续动作分块的生成，从而无需对控制输出进行离散化处理。 跨具身机器人预训练将通用的视觉-语言表示与运动监督相结合，之后策略可通过任务特定的后续训练适应下游的操控任务。

sents.en: π 𝟎 \mathbf{\pi_{0}} ( Black et al., 2025b ) couples a pretrained PaliGemma vision–language model with a dedicated action expert trained using flow matching.

sents.en: Images, language instructions, and proprioceptive states condition the generation of continuous action chunks, avoiding the need to discretize control outputs.

paragraphs.en: π 0.5 \mathbf{\pi_{0.5}} ( Black et al., 2025a ) extends the π 0 \pi_{0} framework with a broader training mixture that includes robot demonstrations, semantic prediction tasks, and non-robot vision–language data. Its hybrid training recipe uses discrete action tokens during pretraining and introduces a flow-matching action expert during post-training for continuous control. In its original formulation, the model can also predict intermediate language subtasks and condition action generation on them, connecting high-level task decomposition with low-level execution.
paragraphs.zh: π 0.5 \mathbf{\pi_{0.5}} (Black et al., 2025a) 通过更广泛的训练混合数据扩展了 π 0 \pi_{0} 框架，这些数据包括机器人演示、语义预测任务以及非机器人的视觉-语言数据。 其混合训练方案在预训练阶段使用离散动作标记，并在后训练阶段引入一种流匹配动作专家以实现连续控制。 在其原始公式中，该模型还可以预测中间语言子任务，并据此对动作生成进行条件约束，从而将高层任务分解与低层执行连接起来。

sents.zh: 在其原始公式中，该模型还可以预测中间语言子任务，并据此对动作生成进行条件约束，从而将高层任务分解与低层执行连接起来。

paragraphs.en: OpenVLA-OFT ( Kim et al., 2025a ) applies an optimized fine-tuning recipe to OpenVLA. Instead of autoregressively decoding discretized actions, it predicts continuous action chunks in parallel and trains the action outputs with an L 1 L_{1} regression objective. The resulting policy also accommodates additional inputs such as multiple camera views and proprioceptive states. It therefore provides a comparison to VLM-based control in which action decoding and fine-tuning are optimized without introducing an iterative diffusion or flow-matching action head.
paragraphs.zh: OpenVLA-OFT（Kim 等人，2025a）将一种优化后的微调方案应用于 OpenVLA。 它没有通过自回归方式解码离散化的动作，而是并行预测连续的动作片段，并使用 L₁ L_{1} 回归目标来训练动作输出。 由此得到的策略还能处理额外输入，例如多个摄像头视角和本体感受状态。 因此，它与基于 VLM 的控制方法形成了对比：后者在优化动作解码和微调时，无需引入迭代扩散或流匹配的动作头。

paragraphs.en: X-VLA ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) uses learnable domain-specific soft prompts to accommodate differences in robot embodiments and data-collection setups. A Florence-2 encoder processes the main image–language stream, while auxiliary camera views are encoded separately. These representations are combined with proprioceptive inputs and soft prompts in a shared Transformer for flow-matching action generation. The prompts provide domain-dependent conditioning without requiring a separate policy backbone for every embodiment.
paragraphs.zh: X-VLA（Zheng 等人，2026）使用可学习的领域特定软提示，以适应不同机器人实体和数据采集设置之间的差异。 Florence-2 编码器处理主图像-语言流，而辅助摄像头视角则被单独编码。 这些表示与本体感觉输入和软提示在共享的 Transformer 中结合，用于生成流匹配动作。 这些提示提供了领域相关的条件信息，而无需为每种机器人实体都配备独立的策略主干网络。

paragraphs.en: Motus ( Bi et al., 2026 ) integrates understanding, video-generation, and action experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. It learns latent actions from optical flow to capture motion information that can transfer across embodiments. Modality-specific diffusion timesteps allow the model to switch among action prediction, video prediction, inverse dynamics, and joint video–action modeling. Its staged training transfers general multimodal priors and motion knowledge from heterogeneous datasets to robot control.
paragraphs.zh: Motus（Bi 等，2026）通过一种混合 Transformer 架构，整合了理解、视频生成和行动专家。 它从光流中学习潜在动作，以捕捉可在不同具现形式间迁移的运动信息。 模态特定的扩散时间步长使模型能够在动作预测、视频预测、逆动力学以及联合视频-动作建模之间切换。 其分阶段训练将通用的多模态先验和运动知识从异构数据集迁移到机器人控制中。

sents.en: Motus ( Bi et al., 2026 ) integrates understanding, video-generation, and action experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture.
sents.zh: Motus（Bi 等，2026）通过一种混合 Transformer 架构，整合了理解、视频生成和行动专家。

sents.en: It learns latent actions from optical flow to capture motion information that can transfer across embodiments.
sents.zh: 它从光流中学习潜在动作，以捕捉可在不同具现形式间迁移的运动信息。

sents.en: Modality-specific diffusion timesteps allow the model to switch among action prediction, video prediction, inverse dynamics, and joint video–action modeling.
sents.zh: 模态特定的扩散时间步长使模型能够在动作预测、视频预测、逆动力学以及联合视频-动作建模之间切换。

sents.zh: 其分阶段训练将通用的多模态先验和运动知识从异构数据集迁移到机器人控制中。

paragraphs.en: Fast-WAM-Joint ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) is the joint-generation variant investigated within the Fast-WAM framework. It couples a pretrained Wan2.2 video diffusion Transformer with an action expert and allows attention between future-video and action tokens during joint denoising. Unlike the main Fast-WAM model, this variant retains future-video generation at inference time. It therefore represents coupled video–action prediction rather than the action-only inference procedure used by Fast-WAM.
paragraphs.zh: Fast-WAM-Joint（Yuan 等，2026）是 Fast-WAM 框架中研究的联合生成变体。 它将预训练的 Wan2.2 视频扩散 Transformer 与动作专家相结合，并在联合去噪过程中允许未来视频令牌与动作令牌之间进行注意力交互。 与主 Fast-WAM 模型不同，该变体在推理阶段保留了未来视频的生成过程。 因此，它代表的是视频与动作的联合预测，而非 Fast-WAM 所采用的仅针对动作的推理流程。

sents.en: Fast-WAM-Joint ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) is the joint-generation variant investigated within the Fast-WAM framework.
sents.zh: Fast-WAM-Joint（Yuan 等，2026）是 Fast-WAM 框架中研究的联合生成变体。

sents.en: It couples a pretrained Wan2.2 video diffusion Transformer with an action expert and allows attention between future-video and action tokens during joint denoising.
sents.zh: 它将预训练的 Wan2.2 视频扩散 Transformer 与动作专家相结合，并在联合去噪过程中允许未来视频令牌与动作令牌之间进行注意力交互。

sents.en: Unlike the main Fast-WAM model, this variant retains future-video generation at inference time.
sents.zh: 与主 Fast-WAM 模型不同，该变体在推理阶段保留了未来视频的生成过程。

sents.en: It therefore represents coupled video–action prediction rather than the action-only inference procedure used by Fast-WAM.
sents.zh: 因此，它代表的是视频与动作的联合预测，而非 Fast-WAM 所采用的仅针对动作的推理流程。

paragraphs.en: Cosmos-Policy ( Kim et al., 2026a ) adapts a pretrained video diffusion model to robot control through latent-frame injection. Robot states, action chunks, and value targets are represented in the existing latent-frame format, allowing the denoising backbone to learn action prediction, future-state prediction, and value estimation without a separate action-specific network. The framework supports direct policy execution and, after refinement using rollout data, value-guided action selection. The LIBERO results in our comparison correspond to direct policy evaluation rather than test-time planning.
paragraphs.zh: Cosmos-Policy（Kim 等人，2026a）通过潜变量帧注入，将预训练的视频扩散模型应用于机器人控制。 机器人状态、动作片段和价值目标均以现有的潜变量帧格式表示，这使得去噪主干网络无需单独的动作专用网络，即可学习动作预测、未来状态预测和价值估计。 该框架支持直接策略执行，并在利用展开数据进行优化后，支持以价值为导向的动作选择。 我们比较中 LIBERO 的结果对应于直接策略评估，而非测试时的规划。

sents.en: Cosmos-Policy ( Kim et al., 2026a ) adapts a pretrained video diffusion model to robot control through latent-frame injection.
sents.zh: Cosmos-Policy（Kim 等人，2026a）通过潜变量帧注入，将预训练的视频扩散模型应用于机器人控制。

sents.en: Robot states, action chunks, and value targets are represented in the existing latent-frame format, allowing the denoising backbone to learn action prediction, future-state prediction, and value estimation without a separate action-specific network.
sents.zh: 机器人状态、动作片段和价值目标均以现有的潜变量帧格式表示，这使得去噪主干网络无需单独的动作专用网络，即可学习动作预测、未来状态预测和价值估计。

sents.en: The framework supports direct policy execution and, after refinement using rollout data, value-guided action selection.
sents.zh: 该框架支持直接策略执行，并在利用展开数据进行优化后，支持以价值为导向的动作选择。

sents.en: The LIBERO results in our comparison correspond to direct policy evaluation rather than test-time planning.
sents.zh: 我们比较中 LIBERO 的结果对应于直接策略评估，而非测试时的规划。

paragraphs.en: GigaWorld-Policy ( GigaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) initializes a unified policy from a pretrained video-generation backbone and trains it to predict action chunks together with action-conditioned future observations. Its blockwise causal attention mask prevents action tokens from attending to future-video tokens, while allowing future-video prediction to depend on the actions. This asymmetric information flow makes future prediction an auxiliary training objective rather than a prerequisite for action generation, allowing future-video synthesis to be omitted during inference.
paragraphs.zh: GigaWorld-Policy（GigaWorld 团队等，2026）从一个预训练的视频生成主干模型初始化一个统一策略，并训练该策略以预测动作片段以及由动作条件化的未来观察结果。 其分块因果注意力掩码防止了动作标记关注未来视频标记，同时允许未来视频的预测依赖于这些动作。 这种非对称的信息流使未来预测成为一个辅助的训练目标，而非动作生成的前提条件，从而在推理过程中可以省略未来视频的合成。

sents.en: GigaWorld-Policy ( GigaWorld Team et al., 2026 ) initializes a unified policy from a pretrained video-generation backbone and trains it to predict action chunks together with action-conditioned future observations.
sents.zh: GigaWorld-Policy（GigaWorld 团队等，2026）从一个预训练的视频生成主干模型初始化一个统一策略，并训练该策略以预测动作片段以及由动作条件化的未来观察结果。

sents.zh: 其分块因果注意力掩码防止了动作标记关注未来视频标记，同时允许未来视频的预测依赖于这些动作。

sents.en: This asymmetric information flow makes future prediction an auxiliary training objective rather than a prerequisite for action generation, allowing future-video synthesis to be omitted during inference.
sents.zh: 这种非对称的信息流使未来预测成为一个辅助的训练目标，而非动作生成的前提条件，从而在推理过程中可以省略未来视频的合成。

paragraphs.en: ACT ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) is a Transformer-based imitation learning method that models action chunks using a conditional variational autoencoder. Given camera observations and robot joint states, it predicts a sequence of future actions instead of a single command. A latent variable captures variation in demonstrations during training, while temporal ensembling can combine overlapping predictions during execution to produce smoother control.
paragraphs.zh: ACT（Zhao 等人，2023）是一种基于 Transformer 的模仿学习方法，它使用条件变分自编码器对动作片段进行建模。 在给定摄像头观测数据和机器人关节状态后，该方法会预测一系列未来动作，而非单一指令。 一个潜在变量用于捕捉训练过程中演示中的变化，而时间集成则可以在执行阶段结合重叠的预测，从而产生更平滑的控制效果。

sents.en: ACT ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) is a Transformer-based imitation learning method that models action chunks using a conditional variational autoencoder.
sents.zh: ACT（Zhao 等人，2023）是一种基于 Transformer 的模仿学习方法，它使用条件变分自编码器对动作片段进行建模。

sents.en: Given camera observations and robot joint states, it predicts a sequence of future actions instead of a single command.
sents.zh: 在给定摄像头观测数据和机器人关节状态后，该方法会预测一系列未来动作，而非单一指令。

sents.en: A latent variable captures variation in demonstrations during training, while temporal ensembling can combine overlapping predictions during execution to produce smoother control.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) models a visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising process over action sequences. Starting from Gaussian noise, it iteratively refines an action chunk conditioned on observation features. Receding-horizon execution incorporates updated observations into subsequent predictions, while the generative formulation accommodates multimodal demonstration behaviors. The diffusion process operates in action space and does not require a pretrained video-generation backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散策略（Chi 等人，2023）将视觉-运动策略建模为对动作序列的条件去噪过程。 从高斯噪声出发，该策略基于观测特征迭代优化一个动作片段。 滚动时域执行将更新后的观测信息整合到后续预测中，而生成式框架则支持多模态演示行为。 扩散过程在动作空间中运行，且不需要预训练的视频生成主干网络。

sents.en: Diffusion Policy ( Chi et al., 2023 ) models a visuomotor policy as a conditional denoising process over action sequences.
sents.zh: 扩散策略（Chi 等人，2023）将视觉-运动策略建模为对动作序列的条件去噪过程。

sents.en: Starting from Gaussian noise, it iteratively refines an action chunk conditioned on observation features.
sents.zh: 从高斯噪声出发，该策略基于观测特征迭代优化一个动作片段。

sents.en: Receding-horizon execution incorporates updated observations into subsequent predictions, while the generative formulation accommodates multimodal demonstration behaviors.
sents.zh: 滚动时域执行将更新后的观测信息整合到后续预测中，而生成式框架则支持多模态演示行为。

paragraphs.en: Octo ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ) is a generalist robot policy pretrained on heterogeneous multi-robot demonstrations. Modality-specific tokenizers encode observations and task specifications, a Transformer fuses the resulting tokens, and a diffusion action head produces continuous action chunks. Tasks can be specified through language instructions or goal images, and the modular design supports adaptation to new observation and action spaces. Although Octo uses a pretrained T5 text encoder, its policy backbone is not initialized from a pretrained VLM.
paragraphs.zh: Octo（Ghosh 等人，2024）是一种通用机器人策略，在异构多机器人演示数据上进行了预训练。 模态特定的分词器对观察数据和任务规范进行编码，一个 Transformer 模型融合生成的分词结果，而一个扩散动作头则生成连续的动作片段。 任务可以通过语言指令或目标图像来指定，其模块化设计支持对新观察空间和动作空间的适应。 尽管 Octo 使用了预训练的 T5 文本编码器，但其策略主干并未基于预训练的 VLM 进行初始化。

sents.en: Octo ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ) is a generalist robot policy pretrained on heterogeneous multi-robot demonstrations.
sents.zh: Octo（Ghosh 等人，2024）是一种通用机器人策略，在异构多机器人演示数据上进行了预训练。

sents.en: Modality-specific tokenizers encode observations and task specifications, a Transformer fuses the resulting tokens, and a diffusion action head produces continuous action chunks.
sents.zh: 模态特定的分词器对观察数据和任务规范进行编码，一个 Transformer 模型融合生成的分词结果，而一个扩散动作头则生成连续的动作片段。

sents.zh: 尽管 Octo 使用了预训练的 T5 文本编码器，但其策略主干并未基于预训练的 VLM 进行初始化。

paragraphs.en: ProgVLA ( Kim et al., 2026b ) combines separate pretrained visual and language encoders with a compact flow-matching action expert. Two stages of Perceiver resampling, placed before and after multimodal fusion, compress observation and instruction features into a small set of context tokens. Auxiliary progress heads, trained with offline reinforcement-learning objectives, estimate task progress and provide advantage- and success-based weights for the imitation objective. This combines representation compression with progress-aware policy training without relying on a pretrained VLM or video-generation backbone. We only consider it in LIBERO, as it does not currently release code.
paragraphs.zh: ProgVLA（Kim 等人，2026b）将独立的预训练视觉编码器和语言编码器与一个紧凑的流匹配动作专家模型相结合。 Perceiver 重采样分为两个阶段，分别置于多模态融合之前和之后，将观察特征和指令特征压缩为一组少量的上下文令牌。 辅助进度头通过离线强化学习目标进行训练，用于估计任务进度，并为模仿学习目标提供基于优势和成功率的权重。 这种方法将表示压缩与感知进度的策略训练相结合，而无需依赖预训练的 VLM 或视频生成主干模型。 我们仅在 LIBERO 中考虑该方法，因为它目前尚未发布代码。

paragraphs.en: We conduct real-world experiments on two dual-arm robots. The policy observes the scene through three cameras (Figure 21 ): one mounted on the head and one on each wrist.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两台双臂机器人上进行了真实世界实验。 该策略通过三台摄像头观察场景（图 21）：一台安装在头部，另外两台分别安装在每个手腕上。

sents.en: We conduct real-world experiments on two dual-arm robots.
sents.zh: 我们在两台双臂机器人上进行了真实世界实验。

sents.en: The policy observes the scene through three cameras (Figure 21 ): one mounted on the head and one on each wrist.
sents.zh: 该策略通过三台摄像头观察场景（图 21）：一台安装在头部，另外两台分别安装在每个手腕上。

paragraphs.en: We make no further architectural changes in real-world experiments. The main difference lies in the training process. We first pretrain on diverse data for more than 10,000 hours, covering 5887 different tasks collected in our real-world embodiments. We train 400k pretraining steps with a batch size of 4096. Then we fine-tune the pretrained model on 10 tasks for 30k steps with a batch size of 512. Both processes adopt exactly same loss function ( ℒ f ​ m \mathcal{L}_{fm} and ℒ t ​ a ​ s ​ k \mathcal{L}_{task} ) and hyper parameters ( λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 , learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , and EMA decay 0.999 0.999 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界实验中，我们不再进行任何架构上的改动。 主要区别在于训练过程。 我们首先在多样化数据上进行超过 10,000 小时的预训练，涵盖我们在真实世界部署中收集到的 5887 项不同任务。 我们以 4096 的批量大小进行 40 万步的预训练。 接着，我们将预训练模型在 10 个任务上进行微调，训练步数为 3 万步，批量大小为 512。 两个过程均采用完全相同的损失函数（ℒ f ​ m \mathcal{L}_{fm} 和 ℒ t ​ a ​ s ​ k \mathcal{L}_{task}）以及超参数（λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01、学习率 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5}，以及 EMA 衰减 0.999 0.999）。

sents.en: We make no further architectural changes in real-world experiments.
sents.zh: 在真实世界实验中，我们不再进行任何架构上的改动。

sents.en: The main difference lies in the training process.
sents.zh: 主要区别在于训练过程。

sents.en: We first pretrain on diverse data for more than 10,000 hours, covering 5887 different tasks collected in our real-world embodiments.
sents.zh: 我们首先在多样化数据上进行超过 10,000 小时的预训练，涵盖我们在真实世界部署中收集到的 5887 项不同任务。

sents.en: We train 400k pretraining steps with a batch size of 4096.
sents.zh: 我们以 4096 的批量大小进行 40 万步的预训练。

sents.en: Then we fine-tune the pretrained model on 10 tasks for 30k steps with a batch size of 512.
sents.zh: 接着，我们将预训练模型在 10 个任务上进行微调，训练步数为 3 万步，批量大小为 512。

sents.en: Both processes adopt exactly same loss function ( ℒ f ​ m \mathcal{L}_{fm} and ℒ t ​ a ​ s ​ k \mathcal{L}_{task} ) and hyper parameters ( λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01 , learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , and EMA decay 0.999 0.999 ).
sents.zh: 两个过程均采用完全相同的损失函数（ℒ f ​ m \mathcal{L}_{fm} 和 ℒ t ​ a ​ s ​ k \mathcal{L}_{task}）以及超参数（λ = 0.01 \lambda=0.01、学习率 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5}，以及 EMA 衰减 0.999 0.999）。

paragraphs.en: For inference, we use synchronous execution, which is the simplest approach. Because our model is small enough to require about 20ms for inference, execution latency is low. The input instructions for the three tasks are directly pick_cup , place_the_spoon_inside_the_bowl , and plug_insert , respectively.
